decks.name: Lesson 1 · Being and naming: sein, pronouns, der/die/das
Lesson 2 · Having things: haben, ein/eine, the accusative
Lesson 3 · Doing things: regular verbs in the present, the verb second
Lesson 4 · Saying no: nicht and kein
Lesson 5 · Asking: W-questions and yes/no questions
Lesson 6 · Counting: numbers 0–20, prices and age
Lesson 7 · Verbs that change their vowel: fahren, essen, lesen, sehen…
Lesson 8 · Family: mein, dein, sein, ihr, unser, euer, Ihr
Lesson 9 · More than one: the plural of nouns
Lesson 10 · Telling the time: the clock, the days, um and am
Lesson 11 · Dates: the months, im, numbers to 100, der dritte Mai
Lesson 12 · For me, without you: accusative prepositions and pronouns
Lesson 13 · Can, must, want: können, müssen, wollen
Lesson 14 · May, should, would like: dürfen, sollen, möchten; mögen
Lesson 15 · The day: separable verbs (aufstehen, anrufen, einkaufen…)
Lesson 16 · Asking and telling: the imperative, bitte
Lesson 17 · To whom: the dative, helfen, gefallen, gehören
Lesson 18 · Getting around: mit, nach, bei, von, zu, aus, seit
Lesson 19 · To me, to you: dative pronouns, es gibt, two objects
Lesson 20 · What I did: the perfect with haben
